CustomField.inlineHelpText: The TER (Total Expense Ratio) corresponds to the total Management fees + Services Fees (or "Com. Mouvements") + Perf. fees expressed as a percentage of the average net assets, excluding transaction costs. It is an ex‑post fee, calculated annually based on the actual costs incurred by the fund Data Owner
CustomField.label: TER (incl perf. fee)
